changelog: 🛡️ Comprehensive Security, Privacy & Offline Reliability Engine (/security)
🔐 Web Crypto API AES-GCM 256-Bit Encryption: Zero-dependency client-side encryption with PBKDF2 key derivation and random 96-bit initialization vectors
👥 6-Role Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Strict least-privilege matrix for Patient, Donor, Caregiver, Hospital, Administrator, and Emergency Responder with default-deny rules
📱 Public QR Hardening & Rate Limiting: 256-bit cryptographically secure tokens, instant token revocation, sliding-window scan rate limiting (max 15/min), and immutable access logging

📶 Offline Synchronization & Conflict Resolution: Encrypted pending sync queue, automatic online reconnection replay, timestamp-based conflict detection, and safe draft preservation during expired auth sessions
💾 Encrypted Backup & Disaster Recovery: Password-protected full clinical archive export (.enc.json) with SHA-256 integrity checksums, restoration report, and 16-character emergency recovery keys
🕵️ Active Session Management & Suspicious Activity: Heuristic detection of unusual devices or locations, remote session termination, and optional two-factor authentication (2FA)

🇮🇳 DPDP Act 2023 Compliance & Consent Center: Itemized affirmative consent notices across 6 Indian languages, immutable consent audit logs, statutory DPO grievance channel, and complete Right to Erasure workflow
🧪 Automated Security Test Suite: 7 interactive automated verification suites with live latency and assertion reporting covering RBAC, token revocation, cross-account isolation, and tamper resistance
🧹 PHI/PII Console Log Scrubbing: Safe logging wrapper preventing unintended exposure of patient health information, phone numbers, emails, and tokens in browser developer logs
